requirements.title: New NASM CPT File Image Addition

patches.decision_note: The initial image-addition task is removed at message 5, while message 9 explicitly assigns image addition for a new NASM CPT file that is later completed. These task-local artifacts require separate lifecycles rather than a second INTRODUCE under the removed Requirement.
The two initial NASM CPT task lines may refer to distinct document artifacts, but the supplied evidence does not safely resolve whether their proofreading obligations require separate Requirements.
